up: Retrieve the compound names, exact activity values (standard_value and standard_units), and assay description for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1054500. Only include rows with exact activity measurements (standard_relation = '='). Do not apply any additional filters on document type, confidence score, or target type. Return all matching rows without any row limits.
sql: SELECT cr.compound_name, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, ass.description AS assay_description FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054500' AND a.standard_relation = '='
